entry: Auto mode is on. These run with no question: tools that only read, edits inside the project folder, and shell commands that only read. These ask you first: anything outside the project folder or on the protected list, deletes, network use, secrets, and workflows (a model never overrides these). Auto never refuses a call by itself: you can always say yes. Auto does not guard what tools that only read can read (read, grep, find, ls, fetch_url, web_search). A sandbox is the boundary, not Auto. /auto-log shows what Auto decided. A shell command that Auto cannot show to be safe is judged by a model, the model of this session. It gets your messages of this session and the command, and answers allow or ask. If it does not allow the command, does not answer in time, or answers in a way that Auto cannot read, you are asked.
